regime.stress_thresholds_note: premium_magnitude, premium_change and platform_spread are deliberately absent. They are calibrated per run from the market's own 30-day distribution by analysis.regime.resolve_stress_thresholds, because fixed values for them fired on 99-100% of readings and made regime_state a constant. Re-adding them here pins them again and silently disables the calibration: explicit config wins by design. volatility, usd_change and news_density stay fixed because nothing has measured whether they are wrong.
